requirement: Pooled Coldcard and CryptoBilis training, evaluated on pooled held-out addresses.
unit: One source address with a fixed reference payment.
target: Documented source-cohort membership for the address's incident.
cutoff: The fourteen pinned predictors from confirmed transactions strictly before each reference block.
feature_policy: Reuse the frozen feature allowlist and missing-value flags. Incident identity and group ID are excluded from the estimator inputs.
groups: Use the audited shared component ID globally, including for components that span both incidents.
estimator: Use the fixed depth-3, minimum leaf 20 balanced decision tree from the pinned earlier experiment.
preprocessing: Median imputation from training folds only, plus one missing flag per predictor.
metrics: Pooled out-of-fold and fold-level precision, recall, F1, AP, ROC-AUC and confusion counts, overall and per incident.
